newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Suramericana de Seguros net profit up.
newsitem.headline: Suramericana de Seguros net profit up.

text.p: Compania Suramericana de Seguros, Colombia's top insurance company and flagship of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, said its net profit rose 16.4 percent in 1996 from 1995 to 52.10 billion pesos.
Other results were not immediately available but the company said it would propose increasing monthly dividends per share by 27.2 percent at a shareholders' meeting set for March 20.

The dividend would be payable between April 1997 and March 1998, it said. The company also said that it intends to float 722,222 shares on local equity markets in the near future but gave no specific date.
